floor_history.headline: Recon s1: floor 28 -> 23 (lost WIP re-applied + two structural corrections); full diff map banked — one coupled arg-home/s-reg-rotation cluster remains, twin func_8008BF04 shares it
Structural: goto-loops rewritten as real C loops restored GCC's loop notes; the whole 4-pseudo callee-save rotation and the entry cluster collapsed. Floor 23 -> 1 (158 vs 159 insns, one addiu left).

frontier.hypothesis: The one missing addiu is the un-folded address materialisation of the outer-loop exit test, and target's C spells that test differently from its top guard.
frontier.mechanism: combine folds (set r (lo_sum (high sym) sym)) into the following MEM unless the register is a named user variable (REG_USERVAR_P); loop.c's scan_loop then hoists any such pointer out of a loop unless it is set in a not-guaranteed-executed basic block. The four pointer placements that satisfy neither constraint were measured this session (9 / 11 / 22 / no-change).
frontier.next_probe: Forensics: cc1 -dL (loop) and -dc (combine) dumps on the sandbox .i, tracing the two D_800F1AF4 test insns from RTL expansion through combine to see which property differs. In parallel (re-derive modality): find a sibling PsyQ/Marionation while(countdown) routine whose exit test compiles un-folded and copy its C spelling; and test whether an alternative file-scope declaration form for D_800F1AF4 blocks the fold at the loop test but not at the top guard and the store.

frontier.hypothesis: func_8008BF04, the queued receive-side twin, carries the same rotation for the same reason and its two regfix rules are retirable by the same rewrite.
frontier.mechanism: Same (u8*, s32) signature, same goto-loop body shape, regfix $19<->$20 @ 0-134 (arg1 s3<->s4) and $16<->$17 @ 68-121, which is the exact rotation the loop notes fixed here.
frontier.next_probe: Rewrite func_8008BF04's loops as real C loops and measure with sandbox --disable all before touching any rule.
